==Acquisition==
'''[[Skill quest]]s'''
*[[The Throwdown in a Norn Town]] ([[Gunnar's Hold]])

==Notes==
* Ear Bite is a touch skill, not an [[attack]]. Therefore, you gain no [[adrenaline]] after use.
* The damage dealt is [[Armor-ignoring damage|armor-ignoring]].

==Trivia==
* The name of this skill most likely refers to an incident in a boxing match in which [[W:Holyfield-Tyson II|Mike Tyson bit Evander Holyfield in both ears]] (and bit a piece of one off) and ended up being disqualified from the fight, and banned from the sport for a time period.
* It appears that the model used in the [[skill icon]] is a male Monk in [[Monk Tyrian armor]].
